crossRefs.note: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought…
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

translations.web: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
translations.bsb: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
translations.kjv: SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
translations.asv: SAMEKH. I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.
